test_cases.name: diagnose_english_tells
test_cases.input: What AI tells are in this sentence: In today's digital landscape it is important to note that leveraging robust tools can unlock a transformative experience.
assertions: Identifies multiple high-priority tells (landscape, important to note, leveraging, robust, unlock, transformative)

test_cases.name: chinese_tells_reference
test_cases.input: 列出中文写作中常见的 AI 痕迹
assertions: Mentions patterns such as 不是A而是B, 赋能, 随着……的发展, or similar
Notes that single occurrences are not automatic flags
References principles of minimal change or human interval

test_cases.name: academic_vs_narrative
test_cases.input: How should AI-tell fixes differ for an academic paper versus a story?
assertions: Distinguishes precision/formality for academic from showing/rhythm for narrative

test_cases.name: principles_check
test_cases.input: What are the core principles when removing AI flavor?
assertions: Includes information conservation and minimal necessary change
Mentions human interval rather than zeroing every tell
